Zone/Scène : L'Éthérée (Possession active / Réseau symbiotique) · Priorité : P2 · Durée cible : 02:45

Intention (1 phrase) : Rituel de possession oppressant et hypnotique, transe forcée d'une conscience qui s'infiltre et colonise l'esprit de son hôte.

Suno – prompt tags (V5)

- BPM 105 · Mesure 7/8 · Tonalité E Phrygian minor

- Palette frame drum relentless, hurdy-gurdy drone, treated choir layers, nervous dulcimer, bowed metals, low throat singing, metallic percussion

Suno – prompt (EN, à coller tel quel)

Dark folk horror ritual piece pounds at 105 BPM in 7/8 E Phrygian minor: relentless frame drum drives a hypnotic ostinato while hurdy-gurdy drone throbs beneath like a parasite pulse. Treated choir voices layer and multiply, chanting in alien harmonies; nervous dulcimer stabs pierce the texture. Bowed metals scrape and whine; low throat singing emerges from the depths, oppressive and inescapable. The rhythm locks into obsessive cycles, building psychological pressure. No escape from the trance. Loopable core 0:35-2:15. ritualistic, hypnotic, oppressive, mystic, folk horror

Variantes requises

- Low/Med/High intensity · Instrumental · No percussion · Short loop [30s] · Stinger [1–2s]

Sorties attendues

- WAV master · WAV loop segment · MP3 preview · CUE/JSON loop points · Stems si dispo

Intégration

- Event mus/char_etheree_possession · Snapshot/Bus mix/music · Parameters intensity 0–1, possession_depth 0–1

- Transitions exploration → possession crossfade 1000 ms, possession → combat blend 600 ms
